criteria.description: Targets the actual drop-off point (disengagement after connecting a bank account / first weeks) from the lifecycle, rather than a generic newsletter for everyone.
Designs behavior-triggered messages mapped to lifecycle stages (onboarding/habit/at-risk/dormant), not time-based blasts to all users.
Each message has one job/CTA that routes the user to the product's value action (e.g. set a budget / review spending), not just 'we miss you / log in'.
Includes frequency/fatigue guardrails (caps, suppression, opt-outs) rather than unconstrained sending.
Measures incremental retention lift with a holdout/control rather than open/click rates, and a rule to kill non-lifting messages.
